<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="rise-of-the-six-4-man-and-duo" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Rise of the Six — 4-Man and Duo</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/boe0MAWJIW.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>RotS is generally done in a team size of 2 but can be done with up to 4 while learning. The fight takes place in a split arena where the team is split into pairs. Each side will have 3 brothers, the order of which changes everyday. However you will spend more time running through tunnels than you will actually fighting the brothers, which is why it is important to be proficient at both dps rotations and movement.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/739965637056659567.png?v=1" alt="persistentrage" title="persistentrage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is a very crucial part of RotS, as this relic allows you to start every kill at full adrenaline.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ At RotS the meta is to AoE the brothers down as fast as possible. Most of the meta and strategy revolves around stacking and luring the brothers so that they can be killed at the same time.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ With the rotations provided the kills that are lurable should all be either 5.4 seconds or lower.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This is an </nowiki><strong><nowiki>advanced guide</nowiki></strong><nowiki> which assumes a strong underlying knowledge of all mechanics and information presented in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#rise-of-the-six-basic</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="useful-unlocks"><ins><nowiki>Useful Unlocks</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Double </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> unlocked is crucial for high kph. They are important in exiting tunnels efficiently.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Equipment with the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1" alt="mob" title="mob" kind="icon" /><nowiki> perk should also be used for this purpose.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Equipment with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1" alt="undeadslayerperk" title="undeadslayerperk" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1" alt="undeadslayer" title="undeadslayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for a flat 7% and 15% (for 10 seconds) respectively.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Both </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1" alt="salveamulet" title="salveamulet" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/855865893808767016.png?v=1" alt="ghosthunterhelm" title="ghosthunterhelm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> work against the brothers.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Undead slayer task lowered to make use to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1" alt="genocidal" title="genocidal" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Fort Forinthry Guardhouse fully upgraded.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="the-fightstrategy"><ins><nowiki>The Fight/Strategy</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>In larger teams both players stand on the same square (DD or death dot) and don’t move unless necessary. Both the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/553050196725071893.png?v=1" alt="Incite" title="Incite" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and DPS pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and may opt to use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/989442220484616242.png?v=1" alt="soullink" title="soullink" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to split both the damage taken and health healed between the two players.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="positioning"><ins><nowiki>Positioning</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The brothers starting positions change everyday, hence your starting position will also change. On each side, three brothers spawn on three separate squares, spawning alphabetically going from North to South (A North, Z South). They will then aggro onto players, and the melee brothers will run to the players. Because the goal is to stack all brothers in AoE radius, the strategy is generally to stand next to Ahrim or Karil and let the melee brothers run to you and stack on top of, or next to Ahrim or Karil.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Because AoE and stacking brothers is the most important part of getting efficient and fast kills, the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/553050196725071893.png?v=1" alt="Incite" title="Incite" kind="icon" /><nowiki> should move as little as possible or else you risk messing up the stack. When you need to move is determined by the daily rotation because each brother does different special attacks. Internalize the special attacks below then you can formulate your own plan of when to move based on the daily rotation. For instance, if it’s </nowiki><code><nowiki>ADG</nowiki></code><nowiki>, you would only move from the starting spot if:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Karil drops a bomb that could damage you or your partner.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Dharok or Guthan do a melee spin on your side.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ahrim specs and becomes unattackable, at which point you should run the brothers to stop taking damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=UCJZ9T8Se54mm98Qsd1O <nowiki>Necromancy</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=7b6beea2-829b-4f5c-b0f8-41fc0919c6e6 <nowiki>Melee</nowiki>]<nowiki>
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F7b6beea2-829b-4f5c-b0f8-41fc0919c6e6.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="rotations"><ins><nowiki>Rotations</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="melee"><ins><nowiki>Melee</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>You are required to have these buffs for this rotation to work:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Undead Slayer ability </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1" alt="undeadslayer" title="undeadslayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Undead Slayer perk </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502804720615441.png?v=1" alt="undeadslayerperk" title="undeadslayerperk" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Undead Slayer task (reduced to 1) alongside Genocidal perk </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1" alt="genocidal" title="genocidal" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Task will not deplete</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Fort Forinthry Guardhouse Slayer Upgrades</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ghost Hunter Helm, Backpack, Legs </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/855865893808767016.png?v=1" alt="ghosthunterhelm" title="ghosthunterhelm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/855865893829476352.png?v=1" alt="ghosthunterbag" title="ghosthunterbag" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/855865893854511144.png?v=1" alt="ghosthunterlegs" title="ghosthunterlegs" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Salve Amulet </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1" alt="salveamulet" title="salveamulet" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Equilibrium perk </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088589627505.png?v=1" alt="eq4" title="eq4" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/tG2tDPHFQ5.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ Stand on the tiles shown above.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Duo</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="berserk" title="berserk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> in the tunnel</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1" alt="undeadslayer" title="undeadslayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + dialogue start → (btc) + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1" alt="tumekenslight" title="tumekenslight" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Notes:</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>Do not stall anything, just let it run you to the most northern brother and naturally use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1" alt="tumekenslight" title="tumekenslight" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and on gcd use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>Btc means backwards target cycle</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>You have be on the following brother rotation for this to work with 2 players using melee:</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><strong><nowiki>West:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Ahrim, Dharok and Guthan</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><strong><nowiki>East:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Karil, Torag and Verac</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="necromancy"><ins><nowiki>Necromancy</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></h3>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>s</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1" alt="deathguard90" title="deathguard90" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → r</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1" alt="deathguard90" title="deathguard90" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1" alt="omniguard" title="omniguard" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /></p>

<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>For easier/learning kills both sides may opt to do a no stall rotation (slightly slower):</nowiki></p>

<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1" alt="touchofdeath" title="touchofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1" alt="omniguard" title="omniguard" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1" alt="deathguard90" title="deathguard90" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /></p>
